add_text_watermark.description: Stamp a line of text across every page of a PDF at a chosen position.
add_text_watermark.name: add_text_watermark

parameters.description: Public URL of the PDF to watermark.
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: Watermark text to place in the PDF.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Horizontal position for the watermark text, in points.
parameters.name: x

parameters.description: Vertical position for the watermark text, in points.
parameters.name: y

url.description: Download link for the watermarked PDF file.

convert_pdf_to_csv.description: Turn the tables in a PDF into a CSV spreadsheet file.
convert_pdf_to_csv.name: convert_pdf_to_csv

parameters.description: Public URL of the PDF to convert.
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: Optional pages to convert. The first page is 0, so 0-2 means the first three pages. Leave blank to convert every page.
parameters.name: pages

csv_url.description: Download link for the generated CSV file.

convert_pdf_to_text.description: Extract the plain text from a PDF using PDF.co.
convert_pdf_to_text.name: convert_pdf_to_text

parameters.description: Public URL of the PDF to convert.
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: Optional pages to convert. The first page is 0, so 0-2 means the first three pages. Leave blank to convert every page.
parameters.name: pages

text.description: The plain text extracted from the PDF.

html_to_pdf.description: Turn HTML content into a PDF file, with an optional file name.
html_to_pdf.name: html_to_pdf

parameters.description: The HTML content to turn into a PDF.
parameters.name: html

parameters.description: Optional file name for the generated PDF.
parameters.name: name

name.description: File name of the generated PDF.

url.description: Download link for the generated PDF file.

list_parser_templates.description: List the Document Parser templates on the account, both your own and the ones PDF.co provides, with the ID needed to parse a document.

templates.description: Parses invoices and extracts invoice number, company name, due date, amount, tax
templates.title: Invoice Parser

list_parser_templates.name: list_parser_templates

remaining_credits.description: PDF.co credits left on the account.

templates.description: The templates available on the account.

id.description: ID of the template, used by the Parse document step.

type.description: 'user' for your own templates, 'system' for the ones PDF.co provides.

merge_pdfs.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document.
merge_pdfs.name: merge_pdfs

parameters.description: The PDFs to merge, in order (at least two). Give one URL per entry, or paste them all separated by commas.
parameters.name: file_urls

parameters.description: Optional name for the merged file.
parameters.name: output_name

merge_pdfs.result_str_template: Merged PDFs into a single file

file_count.description: Number of PDF files that were merged.

url.description: Download link for the merged PDF file.

parse_document.description: Pull the fields and tables out of a PDF or image using one of your PDF.co Document Parser templates: for example the invoice number, due date, and line items on an invoice.
parse_document.name: parse_document

parameters.description: Public URL of the PDF or image to parse.
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: The Document Parser template that says which fields and tables to pull out. PDF.co provides built-in templates (such as Invoice Parser), and you can create your own at https://app.pdf.co/document-parser/templates.
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.description: Optional pages to parse. The first page is 0, so 0-2 means the first three pages. Leave blank to parse every page.
parameters.name: pages

parameters.description: Optional password, if the PDF is protected.
parameters.name: password

fields.description: Each field the template found, by name.

objects.description: The raw result from PDF.co, including each value's position on the page.

page_count.description: Number of pages in the document.

remaining_credits.description: PDF.co credits left on the account.

name.description: Name of the table in the template.

row_count.description: How many rows the table has.

rows.description: The rows, each one a set of column names and values.

template_name.description: Name of the template used to read the document.

template_version.description: Version of the template used to read the document.

read_barcodes.description: Scan a PDF or image and read any barcodes it contains.
read_barcodes.name: read_barcodes

parameters.description: Public URL of the file containing barcodes.
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: The barcode types to look for -- PDF.co needs to know which ones to decode. Give one type per entry, or paste them separated by commas. Common types are QRCode, Code128, Code39, EAN13, UPCA, PDF417, and DataMatrix; see https://docs.pdf.co/api/barcode/read-barcodes for the full list.
parameters.name: barcode_types

barcodes.description: The barcodes found, each with its type, value, and page.

split_pdf_by_ranges.description: Split a PDF into multiple files using page ranges.
split_pdf_by_ranges.name: split_pdf_by_ranges

parameters.description: Public URL of the PDF to split.
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: Where to split the PDF, given as page ranges. The first page is 0, so 0-1,2,3- splits after page 2, after page 3, and keeps the rest.
parameters.name: page_ranges

urls.description: Download links for each split PDF file.

description: Automate PDF conversions, barcode reading, document editing, and data extraction with PDF.co.
